about_the_game:
⬆️ Maximize Your Score!

Your mission: make as many points as possible by harnessing the power of emojis, each with its own unique effect. But be warned—fall short of the target, and it's game over. Strategize, optimize, and push your limits to stay ahead in this high-stakes challenge!



Jump into Blankspace now and see how far your strategy can take you. Will you unlock the ultimate synergies and rise to the top, or will the challenge push you to your limits? Start playing and find out!

name: Blankspace

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 Series or equivalent with support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit OS and processor.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit OS and processor.

short_description: Blankspace is a tactical roguelike where emojis are your tools of strategy. Combine them to generate science, culture, magic, and money. Maximize points with clever synergies. Each run brings new challenges, testing your strategic thinking in a game where no two runs are the same.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish
